units.source_text: 我们的旅馆坐落在下鹈饲。

en.t: Our inn was located in Shimoukais.

units.source_text: 我们三人目送着从长良桥下流淌过去而后消失的篝火，从旅馆走了出来。

en.t: The three of us watched the cormorant-fishing fires drift down past Nagara Bridge and disappear, then came out of the inn.
I was not even wearing a hat.

units.source_text: 在柳濑，朝仓好像是说，你们俩自己去吧，就转身下了电车。

en.t: At Yanagase, Asakura seemed to say, you two go on by yourselves, and turned around and got off the tram.

units.source_text: 车上乘客只有我和道子两人。

en.t: The only passengers on board were Michiko and me.

units.source_text: 电车从这个灯火昏暗的市镇飞速地驶过去了。

en.t: The tram sped through this dimly lit town.
